digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline — Gerrit Verified gate
propositions: Ubuntu default/integration job occupancy exceeds 30 minutes per Verified run due to repeated workflow YAML parsing inside bridge cadence exhaustive minute comprehension and redundant legacy Pandoc subprocess execution in hardening suite.

Bridge cadence test reads and parses _bridge_schedule() YAML 1,440 times inside comprehension loop, consuming 7.65s of 7.93s per-test wall; hoisting schedule load to module level preserves exhaustive minute proof with 0.38s overhead.

Pandoc hardening oracle executes both current and legacy converter on all 884 units for byte-equivalence proof; replacing legacy subprocess side with immutable golden outputs preserves real product conversion assertion while eliminating 883 redundant processes.

Superseded patchset Verify jobs with always() predicates remain running and block successor admission for 24–25 minutes; replacing always() with !cancelled() status check preserves full fallback on classifier failure while enabling prompt cancellation.

AST provenance fixture repeatedly rediscovers enclosing caller and parent relationships across 9.5M walk iterations; building indices once per process preserves all 24 (key, expr, verdict) tuples with existing guards.

Complexity-lock policy runs identical OS/Python-invariant checks in all four matrix cells sequentially; moving single invocation to lint job and removing duplicates eliminates 154 runner-seconds per Verify run without coverage loss.
